name: The Shadowhound's damage follows the owner's PvE Power (#9936)
contract: PvePower::Damage resolved the attacker side only through Unit::ToPlayer, so a pet's hit never picked up its owner's equipped PvE Power. AttackingPlayer now falls back to Unit::GetCharmerOrOwnerPlayerOrPlayerItself when the attacker is not itself a player, so a Shadowhound's melee hit scales with its Witch Hunter owner's PvE Power the same way the owner's own melee hit does. Without PvE Power the hound deals the base 1000. Equipping a chestpiece carrying PvE Power +38 (item 1273, verified by pve-power-damage.json) raises a level 60 player's damage against a creature by 38 x 0.05% = 1.9%, so the hound's hit must rise to 1019 the same way the owner's own hit does. Requires PvePower.Enable = 1 in coa.conf.
